mentions.quote: The meeting was called to order by David S. Ferriero, chairman
Commission Members present: David S. Ferriero, Chairperson
Mr. Ferriero welcomed everyone to the meeting
Mr. Ferriero called for adoption of the agenda
Mr. Ferriero said the plan was an opportunity to codify his belief
Mr. Ferriero pointed to the President’s Open Government initiatives
W. Eric Emerson
Ms. Mahan and Mr. Emerson expressed some concern
Peter Gottlieb
The plan, Mr. Gottlieb said, indicates that this is not business as usual
Mr. Gottlieb said that this adds a layer of context and background to the plan
Karen Jefferson
Ms. Jefferson liked the new mission and vision
Erin Mahan
as Ms. Mahan offered, we are not substituting the work of volunteers
Ms. Mahan and Mr. Emerson expressed some concern
Kaye Lanning Minchew
Naomi Nelson
Ms. Nelson pointed to the importance of collaboration with other funders
Stephen P. Randolph
a memo on a proposed “Course of Action” by Stephen Randolph
Mr. Randolph stated that this plan moves the Commission to a more proactive role
Raymond Smock
Mr. Smock agreed that leadership was important
Mr. Smock asked where the new money would come from
Mr. Smock agreed, saying that certain aspects of professional work can only be done by professionals
Via teleconference George Miles
William G. Thomas, III
Mr. Thomas expressed his enthusiasm for the new plan
Mr. Thomas suggested that we emphasize greater public participation in archives
Kathleen Williams, Executive Director
Ms. Williams agreed that we have to be creative in finding additional resources
Ms. Williams said that we will need three things to make it work
Lucy Barber
Keith Donohue

Darrell Meadows
